epics.title: Rename and Reframe OP to BP
epics.vision: Rename OP artifacts, command surface, docs, and narrative identity to BoroPython (BP) with backward-compatible migration.
target_outcomes: Stable rename map for commands, folders, and docs
Compatibility layer for old OP command aliases

epics.title: Self-Building Runtime Core
epics.vision: Build BP as a reliable autonomous build/runtime loop that can iteratively improve itself without unsafe regressions.
target_outcomes: Deterministic cycle orchestration with safe skip/recovery semantics
Lifecycle tracking across eras/runs per target app
Reliable merge/fan-in completion at run end

epics.title: Personality and Alignment Studio
epics.vision: Define configurable personality, goals, and operating constraints for BP with explicit governance and safety controls.
target_outcomes: Policy and boundary definitions per domain
Simulation-based regression checks for behavior drift

epics.title: Mobile-First Product Platform
epics.vision: Standardize BP-generated products to be mobile-first by default with production-ready app architecture.
target_outcomes: Shared mobile app blueprint and QA gates
Reusable auth, data, telemetry, and release modules
Fast path from mission/scope to shipped mobile app

epics.title: Autonomous Finance Agent (Wallet Maintenance)
epics.vision: Develop a finance-agent platform that can execute user-approved strategies and portfolio maintenance workflows under strict risk controls.
target_outcomes: Explicit human approval boundaries for capital movement
Risk envelopes, stop-losses, and drawdown guards
Auditable execution logs and explainable decisions
epics.notes: High-stakes domain: requires legal/compliance review, regional regulatory analysis, and formal risk controls before production use.

epics.title: Open Source Ecosystem and Contributor Loop
epics.vision: Open-source BP with a contribution model that scales architecture evolution, documentation, and benchmark quality.
target_outcomes: Clear contribution standards and quality gates
Issue taxonomy aligned with epics and lanes
